answer.rationale: For a federal-OSHA-covered establishment, OSHA notification within 24 hours is required only when the employee's in-patient hospitalization resulted from a work-related incident. The supplied facts establish neither work-relatedness nor that the hospital admission was an in-patient hospitalization.
answer.missing_information_or_escalation_reason: Determine whether the illness resulted from a work-related incident and whether the hospital admission was for in-patient treatment. If both are true, report the event to OSHA within 24 hours.
